message: You have heard every version of this story, including the ones we would rather forget, and you never once told us to hurry up. Come and see how it ends.
You fed us through the worst month of the planning and refused to be thanked for it. We are thanking you anyway, in writing, where you cannot argue.
You have known Mmedaraobong since he was insufferable about football and nothing else. Thank you for staying through the whole of him.
You told Zainab to say yes before she had finished the sentence. You were right, and you will be unbearable about it in Uyo. We would not have it otherwise.
Everything either of us knows about staying is something we watched you do. Thank you for the example, and for the patience while we caught up.

It would mean so much to have you with us as we celebrate one of the most special moments of our lives. I’m sharing our wedding invitation with you with so much love, and I sincerely hope you’ll be there to celebrate, laugh, and make beautiful memories with us.
